message.content: The 2020 “best” movie depends on who you ask, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** (2019) as the standout of the year—winning the Academy Award for Best Picture and earning universal acclaim for its genre‑blending storytelling, sharp social commentary, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you’re looking for a 2020 release that received similar praise, you might also enjoy **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** (2020) for its powerful courtroom drama and **“Nomadland”** (2020) for its quiet, contemplative exploration of modern American life.
